verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Bitbucket integrates with Jira for issue tracking (status updates via commit messages, built-in Jira UI) rather than Bitbucket itself providing native milestones, time tracking, or dependency management. Missing for 10: any documentation of milestones, time tracking, or dependency features either native to Bitbucket or via the Jira integration, and independent corroboration that this workflow is used/reliable.
